name: gym-ues-project
description: Sistema de control del Gimnasio UES - Universidad Estatal de Sonora

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start:server
scripts.start:all: npm run build && concurrently -k -n API,DESKTOP -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:server" "npm run desktop"
